name: Haruki no Saidai no Teki wa Risei.
original_name: ハルキの最大の敵は理性。
source:
The girl he's in love with is coming over to his place, alone. Tagokoro Haruki decides on Saturday to prepare for this situation.

Haruki is a virgin, as his raging boner in the morning can prove, and his step-sister — Tagokoro Anne — plots to fool around with his fluttering heart. This leads to him skipping his Saturday shift...

During lunch time, his remarried step-mother — Tagokoro Madoka — plans on seducing him as a way to satisfy the itching inside her. She decides on doing that on that Saturday, when her husband is out of the house.

Haruki's biggest struggle is to stay rational: to beast or not to beast?

His Saturday had just begun.

[from the [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
translation:
他深爱的女孩独自一人来到他的住处。田子春树决定在周六为这种情况做好准备。

春树是个处女，他早上的狂怒就证明了这一点，而他的继妹——田五郎安妮——则密谋愚弄他那颗颤动的心。这导致他缺席周六的轮班……

午餐时间，他再婚的继母——田子圆——计划引诱他，以此来满足内心的渴望。她决定在那个星期六她丈夫外出时这样做。

春树最大的挣扎就是保持理性：野兽还是不野兽？

他的星期六才刚刚开始。
